question: How can validity be attributed to the non-conceptual in relation to conceptual thought?
premises: Some declare validity in relation to conceptual thought.
In that view, the non-conceptual is reached through a sequence of conceptual steps.
The non-conceptual thereby gains recognized validity.
inference: Even the non-conceptual may be treated as valid when it is attained through a disciplined conceptual sequence.
plain_english: For one who declares validity in relation to conceptual thought, the non-conceptual has validity because it is attained through that sequence of conceptual steps.
